name: backdoor/attach-policy
description: Attach AdministratorAccess policy to an existing IAM user or role via Braket Hybrid Job

options.name: TARGET_ARN
options.description: IAM user or role name/ARN to attach the policy to (auto-resolved from caller identity if unset)

options.name: POLICY_ARN
options.description: Policy ARN to attach (defaults to AdministratorAccess)
